description: Sensitivity of the Phi_q-pole-seeded Newton map (thurston-relaxation / conj:algebraic-geometric-dilog-equivalence) at the physical anchors: basin fate per pole seed q0^-(2k+1)+i*delta on the complete-structure 4_1 gluing polynomial, basin-boundary distances in units of the anchor-induced seed shift, and Newton-Jacobian conditioning. Locates (or excludes) the u^3-lever amplification in the seeding stage. Exploratory; no fit; no c_k wired.

data.verdict: Pole-seeded Newton sensitivity at the anchors (complete structure, NZ frame): seed fates are identical across anchors, the minimum seed-to-basin-boundary distance exceeds the anchor-induced seed shift by orders of magnitude, and the Newton Jacobian is O(1)-conditioned. MECHANISM-LOCATING RESULT (scope-(a)): the u^3-lever amplification required for the S anchor-swing does NOT live in the Phi_q-pole seeding stage of conj:algebraic-geometric-dilog-equivalence at the complete structure; it must enter through the m-deformed gluing system (the m(q0) assignment itself), consistent with #3543's near-singular q0->m diagnosis. No ingredient excluded; no fit; nothing wired.
